description: This Java class `SecuredShopPersistableCustomer` extends `SecuredCustomer` and adds fields for CAPTCHA verification (`recaptcha_challenge_field`, `recaptcha_response_field`) and a password check (`checkPassword`). It includes validation annotations and getter/setter methods, serving as an entity or data transfer object in the authentication or customer management module.
